proofDirectoryShapeAsRead.receiptShape: evidence/u14-mainproof-20260917.json has keys unit, stage, at, mergeCommit, checkout, runtime, commands, logs, logHashes, verdict; `logs` is ".sisyphus/roadmap-completion-20260912/u14-main-proof-20260917/ (local; sha256 below)" and `logHashes` is the array of the same `<sha256> *<name>` lines. The manifest this unit writes is the machine-checkable form of that pair.

design.file: scripts/qc/preserve-run-logs.mjs, plain ESM, pure functions plus a CLI, in the style of scripts/qc/machine-idle.mjs and scripts/qc/validate-exact-main-regression-ladder.mjs
design.preserveRunLogs: preserveRunLogs({ runDir, unit, date, preservedRoot, evidenceDir }) copies every regular file under runDir recursively, keeping relative paths, into <preservedRoot>/<unit>-<date>/; hashes source and copy with sha256 and refuses with a typed error naming the file on any mismatch; writes the manifest and returns it. Symlinks and junctions are not followed (lstat-based walk); a runDir that itself resolves through a reparse point is refused. An empty runDir is a typed error, never a vacuous manifest.
design.manifestShape: <evidenceDir>/<unit lowercase>-logs-<date>.json = { unit, date, at, runDir (POSIX path relative to the repository root, never absolute), preservedDir (same), files: [{ file, bytes, sha256 }], bytes (total) }

defaults.evidenceDir: openspec/planning/2026-09-12-roadmap-completion/evidence (the manifest is what the ledger commits)

design.removalPreconditions: removeWorktreeAfterPreservation({ repoRoot, worktreePath, expectedHead, manifest, git }) refuses with a typed error (exit 2 at the CLI) unless ALL hold: the manifest file exists on disk; every file it lists still hashes to its recorded sha256 in the preserved copy; worktreePath resolves to a real directory and is not a reparse point; `git rev-parse HEAD` in it equals expectedHead; `git status --porcelain` in it is empty; and `git worktree list --porcelain` lists it. Only then: delete the node_modules junction FIRST if one exists (the reparse point only, never a recursive walk through it), then `git worktree remove --force <path>`, then `git worktree prune`.
design.injectionPoints: the `git` runner argument of removeWorktreeAfterPreservation, and a copy hook used to corrupt a copy between copy and verify. Both exist only so the pin can drive the branches; neither has a CLI flag and neither has a default that skips a check.
design.cliContract: node scripts/qc/preserve-run-logs.mjs --run-dir <dir> --unit <id> --date <YYYYMMDD> [--preserved-root <dir>] [--evidence-dir <dir>] [--remove-worktree <path> --expected-head <sha>] prints `RUN_LOGS_PRESERVED <manifestPath> <n> files <bytes> bytes` (exit 0), `RUN_LOGS_REFUSED <reason>` (exit 1), `WORKTREE_REMOVED <path>` or `WORKTREE_REFUSED <reason>` (exit 2). No `|| true`, no silent success.

risksForTheParent: NOTHING CALLS THE HELPER after this unit. The proof scripts and the lane cleanup are U17's; until U17 lands the parent must invoke the CLI by hand before every worktree removal, and a removal that skips it loses the logs exactly as U3's were lost.

The preserved copies live under .sisyphus/, which .gitignore line 189 excludes. Only the manifest in evidence/ is committed, so the bytes survive a worktree removal but not a machine loss. That is the stated design, not an oversight.

A junction whose target the helper refuses to walk means a run directory reached through a junction is refused outright rather than partially preserved. If a future lane legitimately stores logs behind a link, it must pass the canonical path.

The removal half runs real git subcommands through an injectable runner. The pin drives it against a temporary repository only; no test and no gate in this unit passes --remove-worktree against a program worktree.

git worktree remove --force is used because a proof worktree can legitimately carry ignored artefacts. The force flag is reached only after the HEAD, clean-state and listing checks pass, so it never substitutes for them - but it does mean an ignored-file manifest is not itself enforced, which is one clause of DELIVERY.md this unit does not implement.
